optimizedDescription.value: Immutable language-neutral model for files, symbols, logical identity, bindings, relations, ranges, and coverage.

optimizedContext.value:
# Symbol Model

## Rules
- `FileNode`: canonical forward-slash `{workspace}:{relativeToCodeRoot}` `path`; `projectRelativePath`; language, content hash, workspace, optional deferred embedding. Equality by `path`.
- `SpecNode`: `specId`, path, title, description, artifact-derived content/hash, ordered `dependsOn`, workspace. Equality by `specId`.
- `SymbolNode`: deterministic location identity `filePath + kind + name + line + column`; name, `SymbolKind`, canonical file path, denormalized `projectRelativePath`, full construct range, exact `selectionRange`, optional comment. Ranges: 1-based lines, 0-based half-open columns; construct non-empty and contains selection.
- Specs, Files, Symbols, Documents use workspace-qualified canonical primary identities.
- Immutable runtime `FileAnalysisDraft`, `FileAnalysis`, `ParserState`, `AdapterSessionState` carry compact symbols, imports, binding/call facts, namespace context, normalized metadata. Distinct from persistence; no AST/tree/cursor retention after per-file analysis.
- Run-scoped lookup contract supports files by canonical path/run ID; symbols by file/simple/qualified name; file↔symbol; specs/documents; spec↔covered symbol; relation deduplication.
- `DocumentNode`: searchable textual non-code node; file identity format including reserved `root:`.
- Closed `SymbolKind`: `function`, `class`, `method`, `variable`, `type`, `interface`, `enum`, `property`. Module/file state→Variable; routine-local state→Variable with routine `parentId`; container state→Property with container `parentId`.
- Closed `RelationType`: `IMPORTS`, `DEFINES`, `CALLS`, `CONSTRUCTS`, `USES_TYPE`, `EXPORTS`, `DEPENDS_ON`, `COVERS_FILE`, `COVERS_SYMBOL`, `EXTENDS`, `IMPLEMENTS`, `OVERRIDES`. Relation equality = source+target+type. `metadata.stale` specifically marks unresolved archived `COVERS_SYMBOL`.
- Hierarchy normalization: type→ancestor `EXTENDS`; type→contract `IMPLEMENTS`; replacing/fulfilling method→base/contract method `OVERRIDES`.
- `ImportDeclaration`: local/original names, raw specifier, relative flag, optional kind. File-only side-effect/dynamic/require/blank forms use empty names; resolution occurs later.
- Scoped immutable facts model scope ownership, source-aware bindings and source kinds, calls, and resolution evidence. Cycle aborts scope lookup. Deterministic facts emit persisted dependency/hierarchy relations; self-relations and unresolved/speculative edges never persist.
- `SpecdCodeGraphError extends SpecdError`; package errors include `InvalidSymbolKindError`, `InvalidRelationTypeError`, `DuplicateSymbolIdError`, `StoreNotOpenError`.
- Logical symbol differs from declaration occurrence; language-defined overload/merge may contribute multiple declarations. Structured workspace, surface, logical owner, symbol space, simple name, `MemberSemantics`, versioned escaped canonical reference are authoritative. Canonical reference stable across location movement; retired single-form encoding rejected.
- Owned logical symbol stores exact dotted `qualified_name`; top-level omits it. Not canonical ID, alias row, simple-name replacement, or FTS surrogate. `::` queries compare as dotted spelling.
- Logical identity carries no package name. `SymbolKind` remains broad; symbol space/member semantics add independent axes.
- `declaringOwner` is canonical logical owner, never parser/location/display ID. Adapter establishes owners before members and emits lexical occurrence `parentId`; shared model has no language list.
- `MemberSemantics`: `kind`, `dispatch`, `accessor`, optional `nativeKind`; retired `MemberForm` absent. Preserve language-defined type/value/namespace-module/property spaces and language-sensitive case; never globally lowercase or collapse differing axes.
- Public binding slot = surface+exported name+symbol space; each target/provenance route has distinct identity, including default/anonymous exports. Local bindings preserve scope/range; aliases, shadowing, competing routes never collapse.
- Persist coverage state and indexed hash for indexed, excluded, unsupported, parse-failed, partial inputs.

## Constraints
- All model/aggregate properties `readonly`; graph changes only through atomic `GraphStore` replacement.
- Structural value equality except deterministic `SymbolNode.id`.
- Adding `SymbolKind` or `RelationType` requires spec change.
- Runtime dependency on `@specd/core`; embedding deferred.
- No runtime/reflection/container/interprocedural/whole-program guessing.
